exposure: continuous Ilioinguinal and iliohypogastric (II/IH) nerve block
cohort: A 33-year-old woman, following emergency cesarean section due to cephalopelvic disproportion, who presented with intractable groin pain and was breastfeeding.
finding: A continuous Ilioinguinal and iliohypogastric (II/IH) nerve block successfully treated intractable groin pain in a breastfeeding patient after cesarean delivery without adverse drug reactions in her infant.
mod_finding: Intractable groin pain, presenting as numbness in the left inguinal area and severe labial pain, occurred after an emergency cesarean section.
